name: CENT.AFR.REP.

flag.title: Five-stripe & star
flag.note: Blue, white, green, yellow + red band

lead: The Central African Republic (CAR) is in the heart of Africa, far from any sea. Lions roam the savanna in the north. At night, stars blaze from edge to edge.

sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: The country sits on a plateau (high flat land) about 600 m high. Rainforest hums with life in the south. Savanna (open grassland) stretches north.
The Ubangi River forms the border with DR Congo. The Karre Mountains rise in the west. Mont Ngaoui, at 1,410 m, is the country's rocky rooftop.
animals: Forests shelter critically endangered (nearly gone) forest elephants, western lowland gorillas and chimps. The bongo, a chestnut-red antelope with white stripes, is Earth's largest forest antelope.
In the north, lions, leopards and giant buffalo herds roam open woodlands. At Dzanga Bai, a jungle clearing, dozens of forest elephants gather daily around mineral-rich mud.
culture: More than 80 ethnic groups live here, each with its own language. The Aka people of the southwest forests sing in four voices at once. UNESCO (a UN culture group) lists this singing as world heritage.
The Gbaya, Banda and Mandjia hold lively mask ceremonies. Sango, the national language, is a creole (mixed language) born from river trade.
history: People have lived here for at least 8,000 years. France named its colony Ubangi-Shari, after two rivers. Independence came on 13 August 1960. Its founding leader, Barthélémy Boganda, died in a plane crash in 1959.
In 1977, army commander Jean-Bédel Bokassa crowned himself Emperor. His $200 million ceremony copied the French emperor Napoleon's. France removed him two years later.
wows: Almost no city lights means the Milky Way blazes like spilled sugar.
Up to 100 forest elephants can gather at Dzanga Bai in one afternoon.
Aka singing is so complex that musicians spent years decoding it, yet children sing it naturally.
Rain falling on one ridge can run to either the Congo or Lake Chad.
CAR has diamonds but no coast, so each diamond travels hundreds of km to a port.
CAR is the country closest to the geographic centre of Africa.
CAR has 772 recorded bird species and 209 mammals.

myths.myth: Diamonds come out of the ground sparkling
myths.fact: Rough diamonds look like dull, cloudy pebbles. Cutters polish them until they sparkle.
Stars shine steadily. Moving air high above Earth makes their light wobble.
